'''Kro Var''' was a barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==Description==
Kro Var was a mostly barren planet with some bodies of water. The [[Ungoth Valley]] was filled with only stone and lava.

==History==
During the [[New Sith Wars]], a ship filled with refugees that were fleeing the [[Ruusan campaign]] came out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] at the wrong co-ordinates and crashed on Kro Var. The survivors organized themselves into clans and fought amongst themselves for the planet's limited resources. Eventually, an organization of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], the [[Shapers of Kro Var]], developed from among the clans and they played a key role in the inter-clan conflicts.

Kro Var was eventually discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] many years later. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] attempted to help the planet's population reintegrate into galactic society.
